wildcard: Multi-year anchoveta collapse: two or more consecutive very strong El Nino years cut Peru's catch to a fraction of normal and hold fishmeal above USD 2,500 per t
impact_channel: Fishmeal price and availability for shrimp, pangasius and marine-fish feed; aquafeed cost; farm margins
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Strongly positive for microbial, algal and side-stream feed protein (insects as benchmark only); negative for aquaculture margins
signposts: NOAA ENSO status; PRODUCE second-season quota (November 2026); IFFO monthly output; World Bank Pink Sheet fishmeal price and fishmeal-to-soy ratio above 6
notes: No longer purely hypothetical: 2026 first season landed about 25% of a record-low quota and NOAA gives over 90% for a very strong El Nino in winter 2026-27. Extreme El Nino frequency projected to double (CLM-27).

wildcard: Mammalian-adapted H5N1 with sustained human-to-human spread (a pandemic from poultry or pigs)
impact_channel: Poultry and pig culls; labour and trade disruption; consumer avoidance of animal products; biosecurity rules; capital flight from risky assets
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Mixed: raises the security case for protein that does not depend on animals (feed aside); short-term capital and demand shock
signposts: WHO reports of human clusters without animal exposure; CDC risk raised above 'low'; H5N1 in pigs in Asia; mammalian-adaptation mutations in Cambodian clade 2.3.2.1e; H5N1 in Vietnamese pigs or cattle; WHO WPRO weekly avian influenza update
notes: Current evidence: 12 human cases worldwide Aug 2025 to Jun 2026, none human-to-human; none in Vietnam. Viet Nam: 130 human cases and 65 deaths since 2003, none in 2026 to 6 Sep 2026; no H5N1 in Vietnamese pigs or cattle in sources read (PAN-01).

wildcard: ASF vaccine escape: recombinant genotype I/II strains spread nationally and a second large pig die-off follows
impact_channel: Pork supply and prices; pork and meat imports surge; feed demand falls sharply; farm consolidation
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Short-term negative for pork supply and prices (people switched to chicken and imported pork in 2019 and 2025) and for feed sales (context); longer-term positive for protein-security policy and closed systems
signposts: Share of recombinant strains in typed samples (above 50% crossed in 2025: north 79%, centre 76%, south 60%); outbreak counts; ASF culls above 2 million pigs a year; vaccine suspensions; sow herd statistics
notes: Recombinant I/II variants reported since 2023; licensed LAVs protect against homologous strains only, and MAE states they have no protective effect against other genotypes (PAN-33). The 2025 wave culled about 1.2 million pigs, about 3.8% of the end-2025 herd, against about 23% in 2019 (our calculation): vaccine escape without a 2019-scale die-off so far. No probability assigned.

wildcard: A cross-protective, safe, DIVA-compatible ASF vaccine ends ASF as a production risk
impact_channel: Pig herd grows faster; more feed and more imported protein needed; integrators expand
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Reduces the disease argument for a second protein source; more pigs and more imported feed (feed context, including microbial feed protein)
signposts: A licensed vaccine with genotype I/II (recombinant) protection (none found by Sep 2026); WOAH-standard vaccine approval; export uptake; stable herd growth above plan
notes: The positive twin of WC-03. MAE (Sep 2025): the three licensed vaccines are genotype II only (PAN-33).

wildcard: Simultaneous maize and soy failure in the main exporters (United States, Brazil, Argentina, Ukraine)
impact_channel: Import prices of maize and soybean meal spike; export restrictions
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive for domestic and non-crop protein; negative for feed affordability
signposts: Synchronous yield anomalies; export taxes or bans; futures spikes; FAO food price index
notes: Published probability for a year with greater than 10% maize loss in all top four exporters: near zero today, 7% at 2 C, 86% at 4 C (CLM-24).

wildcard: Blockade, conflict or insurance shutdown in the South China Sea or Malacca Strait for months
impact_channel: Imports of soybean meal, maize and fishmeal; freight; seafood exports
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Strongly positive for domestic feed-protein capacity and stocks; negative for the economy and capital
signposts: Naval incidents; war-risk premiums; freight indices; strategic grain reserve moves
notes: About USD 3.4 trillion of trade (21% of world trade) passed through the South China Sea in 2016 (CSIS).

wildcard: Strait of Hormuz or wider Middle East closure cutting urea, ammonia, LNG and oil for a year
impact_channel: Fertiliser and energy prices; crop yields; fermentation power and sugar costs
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Mixed: raises costs of all protein; favours energy-light and residue-based processes
signposts: Brent and urea prices; LNG spot; shipping disruptions
notes: Signal in May 2026 of rising energy, shipping and fertiliser costs.

wildcard: Chinese export dumping of yeast, bacterial and mycoprotein from repurposed pharma capacity
impact_channel: Landed prices in Vietnam fall below domestic cost
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for Vietnamese producers; positive for Vietnamese feed and food buyers
signposts: Customs data on HS 2102 and 3504 imports from China; Chinese capacity announcements; unit values
notes: Chinese construction costs about one-sixth of US; Angel Yeast 11,000 t; Cabio about 170,000 t.

wildcard: A sustained soy glut: China cuts soybean-meal use in feed sharply while South American supply grows
impact_channel: Soybean meal price stays low for a decade
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for the economics of alternative feed protein
signposts: Chinese soybean imports; soybean meal inclusion rates; Pink Sheet soybean meal below USD 300 per t
notes: Counter-wildcard to WC-01 and WC-05.

wildcard: Firm renewable power at or below USD 20 per MWh in southern Vietnam (solar plus storage)
impact_channel: Electricity cost for fermentation and electrolysis
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive for power-to-protein and all fermentation
signposts: Auction prices; battery pack costs; direct power purchase contracts for industry
notes: FTG finds power-to-protein reaches the fishmeal band only near 2050 even in good cases.

wildcard: AI-designed strains and enzymes lift food-protein titres above 100 g per L and cut precision-fermentation cost by an order of magnitude
impact_channel: Cost of recombinant proteins; value of fermentation capacity
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive, but gains flow first to owners of large fermentation capacity (China, US, EU)
signposts: Peer-reviewed titres; TEA with commodity prices below USD 5 per kg; contract prices
notes: FTB found no evidence of lower production cost at scale yet.

wildcard: Cell-free protein synthesis reaches food cost
impact_channel: Decentralised protein production without living cells
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive for design-led entrants; disrupts fermentation investments
signposts: Cost per gram falling below USD 0.1
notes: FTB: best cost about USD 2.7 per mg (modelled antibody); 5 to 8 orders of magnitude too high.

wildcard: A serious novel-food safety scandal in Asia (illness cluster, toxic contaminant or undeclared allergen in a new protein ingredient)
impact_channel: Regulator tightening; consumer trust; reliance routes paused
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for food applications; feed less affected; raises value of testing infrastructure
signposts: Adverse-event clusters; recalls; emergency rule changes
notes: Precedent: 2022 US Daily Harvest product with a new ingredient caused 393 illnesses and 133 hospitalisations.

wildcard: A protein-adulteration scandal in feed or food (melamine-type fraud) implicating an alternative protein ingredient
impact_channel: Testing regimes; import bans; buyer audits
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative short term; positive for accredited protein testing (amino acids, digestibility)
signposts: Customs alerts; RASFF notices; MAE feed inspection results
notes: Version 0.1 found no Vietnamese lab offering amino-acid digestibility tests.

wildcard: EU or major buyers apply carbon or deforestation rules to aquafeed ingredients in imported shrimp and pangasius
impact_channel: Feed footprint becomes an export condition
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive for low-footprint local feed protein (residue-based, microbial, algal)
signposts: CBAM scope review; EU deforestation rule extensions; retailer Scope 3 feed targets; ASC feed standard
notes: CBAM already covers fertilisers and hydrogen (definitive phase from 1 Jan 2026) but not food.

wildcard: Extreme Mekong dry-season salinity worse than 2016 and 2020 (El Nino plus upstream storage)
impact_channel: Rice, fruit and freshwater aquaculture losses; land shifts to shrimp
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Mixed: more aquafeed demand, fewer rice by-products; positive for land-free protein
signposts: NCHMF salinity bulletins; MRC flow data; distance of 4 g per L isohaline
notes: The 2016 and 2020 records both followed strong El Ninos; 2027 dry season is a live risk.

wildcard: Delta subsidence accelerates (unregulated pumping), forcing abandonment of large pangasius and shrimp zones before 2050
impact_channel: Relocation of aquaculture; feed demand geography
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Mixed
signposts: InSAR subsidence rates; groundwater extraction licences
notes: CLM: subsidence about 1.1 cm a year, ten times global sea-level rise.

wildcard: Sector-wide exit of cultivated meat (most leading firms fail by 2030)
impact_channel: Talent and equipment released; investor aversion to all 'lab food'
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for cultivated; positive for cheap second-hand bioreactors for feed fermentation
signposts: Closure count; Singapore and US product withdrawals; funding below USD 50 M a year
notes: Cultivated funding USD 74 M in 2025, down 49%.

wildcard: Cultivated chicken reaches price parity with conventional chicken in one market
impact_channel: Rapid demand shift in premium markets; capital returns
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive for the category; Vietnam lacks capacity so gains go elsewhere
signposts: Wholesale price below USD 10 per kg at over 100,000 t; food-grade media below USD 1 per L
notes: Rethink Priorities panel: 6% chance of over 100,000 t at under USD 10 per kg by 2031.

wildcard: Cultivated-meat bans spread to large Asian markets or a negative halal ruling in a major Muslim-majority country
impact_channel: Market access; investor sentiment
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for cultivated; little direct Vietnamese exposure
signposts: Legislative bills; fatwa councils; trade disputes
notes: Seven US states ban or pause; Malaysia's 2025 fatwa is favourable.

wildcard: A synthetic-biology biosecurity incident (lab release or AI-enabled misuse) triggers global controls on gene synthesis and engineered microbes
impact_channel: GMO and fermentation permits; biofoundry access; cross-border strain transfer
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for precision fermentation and engineered strains; neutral for non-GM biomass
signposts: Gene-synthesis screening mandates; biosafety convention changes; incident reports
notes: No source; included for completeness.

wildcard: Carbon pricing reaches livestock (methane) in Vietnam or key export markets at over USD 50 per tCO2e
impact_channel: Livestock cost; value of low-emission protein
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Positive
signposts: Vietnam ETS scope after 2029; NDC 3.0 agriculture caps; buyer carbon pricing
notes: Official caps exist; no price on agriculture yet.

wildcard: New shrimp disease pandemic cuts Vietnamese shrimp output by a third or more
impact_channel: Aquafeed demand; feed-mill utilisation
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for aquafeed-protein ventures in the short term
signposts: Disease reports; post-larvae sales; feed-mill volumes
notes: Past EMS/AHPND waves are the precedent; not re-sourced here.

wildcard: Singapore or another ASEAN regulator withdraws from novel-food leadership (approvals slow or stop)
impact_channel: Loss of a reference regulator for reliance
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Negative for a Vietnamese reliance-based route
signposts: SFA approval pace; policy statements
notes: Singapore dropped '30 by 30' in November 2025 but kept approving in 2026.

wildcard: ASEAN mutual recognition of novel-food approvals within five years
impact_channel: One dossier for ten markets
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Strongly positive for a Vietnamese hub and contract manufacturing
signposts: ASEAN food-safety committee texts; Vietnam's food-law decree
notes: Positive policy wildcard; v0.1 Scenario 3 driver.

wildcard: Mass uptake of appetite-suppressing drugs (GLP-1 class) in urban Asia lowers food intake but raises demand for protein-dense foods
impact_channel: Macro demand input only
direction_for_vn_alt_protein: Mixed; small effect on feed balance
signposts: Drug prices; national uptake statistics
notes: Demand side; included only as a macro input to the balance model.
